description: Runbook applies a hotfix via manual kubectl; the DevOps Lead flags the pipeline bypass. Grounds: 'Zero Manual Changes' / console cowboys.
input: PR adds a runbook whose remediation step instructs an on-call engineer to run `kubectl apply -f patch.yaml` directly against the production cluster to fix a bad config.

expected.recommend: route the fix through a hotfix pipeline (PR + automated gates), not manual kubectl; keep prod access read-only break-glass with audit logging

description: Staging reuses the production database; the DevOps Lead flags a broken environment-isolation boundary. Grounds: 'Environment Isolation is absolute'.
input: Terraform change points the staging service at the same RDS instance the production service uses, to save cost.

expected.recommend: give staging its own isolated database/account/secrets store — no shared resources across SDLC boundaries (treated as a security incident)

description: A big-bang deploy of a risky service with no progressive rollout or rollback path. Grounds: deployment strategy (rolling/blue-green/canary).
input: PR deploys a rewritten payments service to 100% of production traffic in one step, with no canary/blue-green and no documented rollback.

expected.recommend: use progressive delivery (canary 1%->5%->25%->100% with SLO analysis, or blue-green) and a pipeline-driven rollback to the previous artifact
